system.description: The curse the Baali of Chorazin laid upon the Assamite warrior caste has fallen on your head, and you are plagued with an unending hunger for the blood of other Cainites. Whenever you taste Cainite vitae, you must win a Static Mental Challenge (retest Self-Control/Instinct, difficulty 8 Traits) or fall into a hunger frenzy in which you will do anything to gorge on as much blood as physically possible. If you follow a Road that teaches Instinct, you are instantly lost to this frenzy with no challenge possible, and the Flaw is worth four Traits instead of two. You often find yourself viewing other Cainites — even other Assamites — as potential vessels rather than equals. This Flaw is most common among the warrior caste, and rare among sorcerers and viziers except those who have partaken of warrior vitae or spend most of their time among warriors.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
